description: Mobility Database (catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime feeds) is a catalogue listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by MobilityData. MobilityData's open catalogue of public transport feeds lists 3,736 active GTFS schedule and GTFS Realtime feeds from 2,287 providers in more than 100 countries, with the location of each feed, its provider, the URL of the feed, its licence link and the GTFS features it uses. Coverage: more than 100 countries, with the United States, France and Japan the largest. Feeds are re-downloaded and validated by the Mobility Database, which stores the latest copy of each feed. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per feed (most feeds carry an open licence link). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
